description: CexChain protocol objects added in specification revision v0.5 (ownership assets), built by an independent Python encoder from spec/cexchain.cddl: a home ledger whose registrar (a device with a delegation for statement type 20) and organization take a receivable and a warehouse receipt through every asset action, citing consents from three other ledgers; statements the ledger rules must refuse, each to be validated against the state after the first `after` statements, registered at t0 + 1000 + index; the consents' metadata; the expected final state of each asset; and asset evidence. Consent records and evidence bundles of other ledgers are opaque bytes here (bundles have their own vectors): a consent reference pins HASH(bundle) under the home's hash. All signatures are Ed25519 (deterministic). Keys are throwaway test keys: seed = SHA-256("CexChain test key: <name>").

statements.name: delegate asset actions to the registrar
endorse the receipt as inspector (not a change of its head)
pledge the receivable to the bank
pledge the receipt to the bank
transfer the receivable to the buyer

refused.name: a receivable held by its home
a receivable in a lower-case currency
pledge it with the head before the pledge
transition an asset as a record
redeem a pledged receipt without the pledgee
release consented by the holder, not the pledgee
transfer without the new holder's consent
